entries.input: Determine the continuous functions $f$ from the positive reals to the positive reals with $f(xf(y)) + f(yf(x)) = 1 + f(x+y)$ for all $x, y > 0$. Prove that every such $f$ is $f(x) = 1/(1+cx)$ for some $c \geq 0$.
